facts.activity_file: supporting a load for maintenance access

assets.label: workshop hoists and press
assets.service: heavy vehicle component removal and pressing

control_failures.control_label: inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear
mechanical support of a load during maintenance access

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: vendor notification - premature wear on LIFT-CLASS-W

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LIFTING_GEAR_INSPECTION: the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear on HO-9403 and M-9403 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining lifting appliances, specifically supporting a load for maintenance access. HO-9403 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during routine operation while the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear had degraded below its design intent. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 16 December 2011 the original equipment manufacturer issued an advisory affecting HO-9403 and M-9403 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop.
